overview_description.description:
Onshore is an AI-powered tax platform that pairs intelligent automation with human tax expertise to help businesses unlock, optimize, and defend complex incentives like the R&D Tax Credit, 179D Deduction, and Cost Segregation studies.

Onshore cuts study timelines from 270 days to just 28, helping companies file in weeks, at 30–50% lower cost, while uncovering up to 15% more eligible credits. 

Founded in 2020 and based in New York, Onshore serves businesses across industries and is trusted by leading accounting firms, SMBs, and Fortune 1000 enterprises.

product.name: R&D Tax Credit Platform
product.description: An AI-powered software platform that automates the identification, calculation, and reporting of Research and Development tax credits for businesses.

product.name: 179D Deduction Service
product.description: A service that uses AI to analyze building plans and energy systems to identify and document eligible energy-efficient commercial building tax deductions under Section 179D.

product.name: Form 6765 Diagnostic Service
product.description: A diagnostic service that assesses existing R&D tax credit reports against new IRS Form 6765 requirements to identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.

product.name: AI-Enhanced R&D Credit Interview Process
product.description: An AI-driven approach that reduces the time and effort required for R&D credit interviews by predicting qualified research activities and time allocations for validation.
